# Natalia E. Valencia Donat, Assoc. AIA, LEED AP BD+C

> Design lead and project manager in New York, NY, and President of the NYC Architecture Biennial (NYCAB). This site (https://nv-projects.com/) is her portfolio: architecture projects she worked on at leading firms, and her NYCAB leadership.

## Roles

- Design lead and project manager, New York, NY
- President, NYC Architecture Biennial (NYCAB)
- Credentials: Assoc. AIA, LEED AP BD+C

## Past firms

- Cesar Pelli & Associates
- Kevin Roche John Dinkeloo and Associates (KRJDA)
- KPF
- Gensler
- FXFOWLE
- Perkins Eastman
- Richard McElhiney Architects

- 2024 NYC Architecture Biennial and NYCAB Inclusion Award ceremony, New York Institute of Technology, Manhattan
